title: Adopt the requirement first workflow for active work
actor: A project maintainer adopting the replacement workflow
goal: Move active work to one coherent workflow while preserving original approvals and actual obligations.
context: The project selects the replacement workflow for new or existing work; earlier contracts, records and judgments may remain applicable to part of that work.
trigger: The maintainer requests adoption for an explicitly selected scope.
preconditions: The requested scope and relevant project authority are identifiable.

interaction.action: Selects the adoption scope and identifies current work, contract consumers and prior review subjects.
Presents replacement responsibilities, active-work dispositions, supported recording and any incompatible dependencies.
Authorizes the coherent adoption when its prerequisites are established.
Reports the active contract and remaining work without fabricating or relabeling historical judgments.

expected_outcome: The selected work uses one coherent requirement-first contract with truthful current obligations and preserved history.

alternatives.condition: The selected project has no earlier records.
alternatives.outcome: The project can adopt after establishing supported recording, authority and coherent workflow prerequisites, without importing historical records.

alternatives.condition: Selected existing work already has compatible recording support.
alternatives.outcome: Adoption can proceed after the work and its retained dependencies are explicitly disposed of and the applicable authority and coherent workflow prerequisites hold.

alternatives.condition: Selected work depends on incompatible earlier records and required migration is unavailable.
alternatives.outcome: Affected adoption remains blocked; the system identifies the unmet dependency and actual active authority while preserving work and historical judgments. Empty replacement records cannot discharge those dependencies, and unrelated history is not automatically imported.

alternatives.condition: Old milestone reviews remain useful evidence.
alternatives.outcome: Their original scopes are preserved; they are not relabeled as whole-change or requirement approval.

failures.condition: A validator or installed skill still demands the replaced approval cycle.
failures.outcome: Adoption remains incomplete and that dependency is identified; fake clean reviews are not created.

failures.condition: Adoption is interrupted or active-work disposition is unresolved.
failures.outcome: The system exposes the actual active contract and preserves work; conflicting rules are not advertised as a coherent adopted workflow.

sources.basis: User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.

Document-based author assessment under the explicit Constitution exception confirms this Scenario as requirement-analysis knowledge. It is not independent review, executed product evidence or workflow activation.

User-authorized scope refinement: compatible recording for selected work, historical import only when required by its dependencies, and blocked affected adoption when necessary migration is unavailable. Preserve identities, original judgments and separate portable authoring; no workflow activation or migration is performed.
